ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity (white) to 30% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous lobes with a central black anchor-shaped region. Black stippling and mottling are mapped along the trailing edges and concentrated at the fluke tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge, with increased irregularity toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory on the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering into acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, circular white pixel groups (barnacles) visible at the extreme lateral tips of the left and right flukes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: At least four distinct, dark vertical linear disruptions (rake marks) on the left lobe and similar, less distinct marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Barnacle encrustations at the fluke tips; multiple vertical rake mark scars; a specific circular pigmentation mark or scar on the lower inner right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive circular dark mark located on the white pigmentation of the inner right lobe.
